pairing: heldout seed and condition; four independent seeds, repeated conditions not independent replications

adaptation_lag.definition: first cycle offset after each change whose uptake and following cycle uptake both reach 4.0; window-censored if no such pair
adaptation_lag.justification: two thirds of nominal total ability 6, fixed before any d3 execution; also publish all cycle values and do not treat this threshold as comprehensive adaptation evidence

inference: descriptive paired seeds, all signs and ranges retained; no test-seed tuning, no scalar winner declaration

units.body_time: sum of pre-step body mass, unit-step duration
units.cost: energy payments separately, no double count of heat or precursor material

interventions: freeze and permute share the exact learned eight-cycle physical/controller prefix; permutation exchanges cue content, not a spatial locality test
nulls: no improvement over last/EMA means no demonstrated extra value for learned update rule
saved_process: predeclared first heldout seed changed world, all arms, four phases per cycle; partial temporal samples not every intermediate field
